excerpt: Repeating the procedure for several nuclear separations R gives the bond dissociation curve. After correcting computed energies for experimental errors, the equilibrium bond length was R = 92.3±0.1 pm, with corresponding ground-state electronic energy E = -2.865±0.008 MJ mol^-1. More than 96% of the experimental data are within chemical accuracy with respect to theoretical values.
overview: This is the main quantitative result. It shows that the hybrid photonic solver produced a chemically meaningful molecular curve for a minimal-basis He-H+ problem, while the need for systematic-error correction and comparison to a full-configuration-interaction curve limits the result to a proof of feasibility.
title: He-H+ Dissociation Result
